plan.name: Show SANY errors in failed TLC runs
plan.summary: When SANY prevents TLC from parsing or semantically checking a module, put SANY's complete error diagnostics and source locations in the failed Result.Message, in printed order before TLC's closing failure message, so an agent can repair the model from the check result. Extract those diagnostics from SANY's unframed output without adding routine parsing or progress text, and preserve Result.Printed, outcome classification, existing TLC error messages and the fallback for other failures. The enriched message must flow through the formalizer's check feedback, the gate's JSON and Markdown receipts, and the factory's failure posts and pull request body, using their existing rendering and clipping rules. Document the behavior in SPEC.md and docs/gate.md, with the SPEC bullet citing D-0000, D-0013 and D-0092 for verifier feedback and receipts. The merger records the new two-way decision for retaining SANY diagnostics, since the plumbing build cannot write decisions/.

tests.name: TestSANYParseDiagnosticsPreserveOtherTLCResults
tests.says: A misindented conjunction reports SANY's full line and column diagnosis before TLC's closing error, while unrelated failures, successful runs and Printed retain their existing behavior.

tests.name: TestSANYSemanticErrorsKeepLocationsAndPrintOrder
tests.says: Every undefined-operator diagnostic keeps its module, source range and message, in SANY's printed order before TLC's closing error, without truncation, duplication or routine progress text.

tests.name: TestSANYErrorsReachCheckReceiptAndFactoryPosts
tests.says: A failed formalizer model check carries the SANY error and location through check feedback, JSON and Markdown receipts, and factory failure posts and the pull request body.
